items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: You see, because old man Bouchelle that was his name, he owned the Half Way House and owned another place in New Orleans.

ctx.x: But I got fired for fighting, the head waiter. You see, because old man Bouchelle that was his name, he owned the Half Way House and owned another place in New Orleans. And he left word for this head waiter to give us what we wanted to eat. And this head waiter had taken it over to give us what he wanted us to eat, you see. And I told him, I said, well the boss said that to give us what we wanted to eat, see? And boy, we got to scuffling there and everything, see? And I got fired that night, see? Over this food…
